old: Access to LUMI requires membership of a project that has already been granted resources; a Resource Allocator in one of the 13 consortium countries creates the project and invites the PI and members, and the institutional email address is mandatory under the terms of use.
new: To access LUMI, you need to be a member of a project that has been granted resources on LUMI. The LUMI consortium countries have different policies for accessing LUMI. In general, a Resource Allocator (RA) must create a project and invite the Principal Investigator (PI), i.e. the lead researcher and members to the project. According to LUMI Terms of Use you must use your institutional email address.
